notes.title: Empire Live Devlog
notes.content:
[b]We are currently working on a big update for Empire Live !
The following will be included:[/b]

- You'll be able to choose which class you want when exploring the map
- Some changes will be made on the map, especially on mountains
- A total rework of the pathfinding, your units will now go where you want them to be without being blocked against cliffs or going through water
Beside this, you'll gain in performance when moving your units compared to before!
- Each Haran's citizens will have a name and you'll be able to talk to them!
- We will add new citizens to Haran that will walk in the city
- A quest system will also be added, simply talk to a character in Haran and you'll be able to do a quest for them, They will give you some gold for each completed tasks
This system will be procedural, you'll always have quests to do!
-We will also fix some bugs.

All fixed bugs will be detailed in the patchnote when the update will be available!

notes.title: Empire Live Patchnote V0.2.5
notes.content:
[h1]Empire Live Patchnote V0.2.5:[/h1]

[list]
[*]  The skill's description in Alberic's menu now display when hovering the icon
[*]  In the main menu when you hover a button, a description will appear
[*]  When entering the neutral city of stoneshade, a message will be displayed on screen
[*]  We have added a sandbox mode where you'll be able to build an empire without worrying of being under attacked
[*]  The wizard's frost spell will now follow the ground instead of going on a straight line
[*]  We have added Empire Live's logo and a loading icon to the loading screen
[/list]

notes.title: Empire Live Patchnote V0.2.4
notes.content:
here is the 0.2.4 patchnote, some visuals have been changed and some bugs have been fixed:


[h1]Empire Live Patchnote V0.2.4:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  The sword base in the Fairy area has been centered
[*]  Borders near water have been adjusted
[*]  Improvement of rock textures
[*]  Improvement of ground borders textures
[*]  Mountains in Haran have been reworked
[*]  The name of your opponent will now always face you
[*]  You will no longer be able to move while dead
[*]  Units killed against the AI will now display correctly in the statistics at the end of your game
[*]  The difficulty of the AI in normal, Hard and Epic has been reworked
[*]  It is now easier to hit Big units with your fireball (giant, golem, guard)
[*]  At the end of each tutorial, the end message will now fade in
[/list]

notes.title: Empire Live Patchnote V0.2.2 & V0.2.3
notes.content:
[h1]Patchnote V0.2.2:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The warrior's Lumberjacks will not spawn in the sawmill anymore
[*]  The teleportation area as been changed in a camp in the west of the map
[*]  The cost of the spell of greed is now displayed in Alberic's Menu
[*]  The watermill near Gorria is actually spinning now !
[*]  Trees spawned by the sawmill won't appear under the ground
[*]  Giants, golems and guard's feet will now touch the ground
[*]  We have worked on a bug that take off collision on multiple buildings, it shouldn't appear anymore. If by any chance it is still happening, let us know !
[/list]

[h1]Patchnote V0.2.3:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  The meteor spell will now hit more units in it's area
[*]  The mana cost of the fireball has been reduced from 14 to 10 mana
[*]  The fireball now makes aoe damages, we have also reduced the amount of damages it makes from 40 to 20 as it hits more than one units now
[*]  Units of your opponent will now not be able to go inside your buildings
[*]  Units are now a little bit bigger in order to increase lisibility
[*]  We have changed the Gems tutorial to be more specific on how to use your gems to improve your units
[*]  The logo on the main menu has been changed to a better quality one
[*]  We have fixed a bug that used to make some text invisible for people who play the game in english
[*]  We have increased the amount of gold you earned at the end of each games

[/list]

notes.title: Empire Live - Bug corrections
notes.content:
[b]Thanks for your feedback. It has helped us correcting some bugs player have encountered when playing. We have posted an update in order to correct those bugs.[/b]

[h1]Patch-note:
[/h1][list]
[*] Borders are now visible when using the RTS view
[*] The bomb scale of the Gobelin as been reduced
[*] Binding controls now works[b] If you have changed the inputs before the update and are still having an issue for binding some keys. Just go to your appdata folder (%appdata% in your windows folder search bar) and go to appdata/local/empirelive/saved/config/ and delete the input file.[/b]
[*] Logos when gathering resources have been changed to match those in the HUD
[*] Pressing F1 now shows the Help menu in the language that you choose in the settings
[*] Units will be less likely to be blocked on edges, we are actually working on better improvements.
[*] Inputs are now automatically  bounds to the language you choose in the settings (WASD for English, ZQSD for French)
[*] Units will not block anymore when having an army of more than 500 units
[*] Units won’t block between them
[*] For the moment, when teleporting on a camp, you’ll be teleported a little higher in order for you to not be blocked in some trees or other assets.
[/list]

[*] Binding controls now works
[*] Logos when gathering resources have been changed to match those in the HUD
[*] Pressing F1 now shows the Help menu in the language that you choose in the settings
[*] Units will be less likely to be blocked on edges, we are actually working on better improvements.
[*] Inputs are now automatically  bounds to the language you choose in the settings (WASD for English, ZQSD for French)
[*] Units will not block anymore when having an army of more than 500 units
[*] Units won’t block between them
[*] For the moment, when teleporting on a camp, you’ll be teleported a little higher in order for you to not be blocked in some trees or other assets.
